name: Darian
review: Thanks a lot for letting us stay! It was a beautiful place with plenty of room! Would absolutely book again

name: Peter
review: Eugene's place was excellent for our outing with 18 guys. Plenty of beds and bunks, large eating area and we were able to use the fire pit outside. The game room in the basement was welcomed for foosball and pool. It's right next to Emerald Lake with places to swim, boat and hike and easy drive into Manchester with plenty of places to eat and shop. Plenty of parking on site as well.. Hosts were easy to work with and communicated well before and during our stay. Highly recommend this place!

name: Judd
review: All in all, we enjoyed our stay in this spacious house. We appreciated that it was walking distance to gorgeous Emerald Lake, and the kitchen was huge and very well appointed with everything you need. While there are a great number of beds in the house, the mattresses themselves are very low quality and in need of an update. Perfect for a large group of kids perhaps, but not for adults who want a comfortable night of sleep. Renters should also be aware that this house is located directly on Route 7, so you will hear the sound of large trucks speeding by from just a few feet away from your bedroom early in the morning. Owners were on site in their attached residence, but were very friendly and there were no sound issues.

name: Alison
review: Loved the property! It was spacious enough for our party of 11. Very cute and cozy - would love to stay here again!

name: Mikala
review: Eugene's place was perfect for our large group! Plenty of beds and dining seating, and nearby to a variety of things to do.

name: Cameron
review: Our group rented Eugene's house and barn for the July 4th weekend. His communication was top notch, even while he was away on his own vacation. With our group of 14, we didn't feel cramped in the home and were able to properly relax. Finally, I would HIGHLY recommend renting the art barn they have out back. The vibes are immaculate, the ambiance is eclectic and inviting; you won't find another spot like it in the area. Thanks Eugene and co. for providing us with a fantastic getaway!

name: Laurie
review: Great place for a gathering!

name: Hsiang Ling
review: It's a great place for large group. Kitchen and living room are large and comfortable for gathering.

name: Melissa
review: The perfect house for our large group. Comfortable, lots of space, and a well-stocked kitchen. We would stay again.

name: Virginia Anne
review: Gene was an awesome host. My group was large and the space accommodated us all comfortably. He fixed and addressed all issues swiftly!

name: Liz
review: Excellent experience

name: Megan
review: This is a great house for a large group who wants the best value for their money. It has all the necessities without any extras that add on costs for you. We enjoyed our stay and were comfortable.

name: Christian
review: The house is large and accommodative for our large group. Very big kitchen area where our group was able to congregate.

name: Amie
review: Eugene's place was a great stop for our large group visiting the area. Plenty of bedrooms and bathrooms, which can be a challenge for large groups. The kitchen was a great place to gather for group meals and the basement was a great spot for our kids to hang out and have fun. Beautiful area with lots to do if you like the outdoors!

name: Joanne
review: We had a large group and there was a generous supply of towels and kitchen supplies which made it a pleasure.

name: Cheri
review: Eugene was quick to say that they would respond to any problems as they wanted the highest rating they could get. But when we let him know that the house was full of flies and there was no fly swatter he did nothing , we killed upwards of 20 flies a day while we were there. Bed slats fell out of the beds and when we let him know that we were asked if we could take care of it ourselves. We also let him know that the bathroom door off the living room would not latch. There was no response.

name: Emily
review: The place was perfect for our large group of 10! With plenty of bedrooms, bathrooms, and communal space; we felt right at home. The large kitchen table provided the perfect space for our Friendsgiving meal and the kitchen was stocked with plenty of supplies (silverware, dishes, cups, etc). The hosts were very responsive, addressing any questions right away. Manchester Center is just a short drive away with access to shopping, restaurants, and cute coffee shops. The house is the perfect spot to feel private and removed from all the hustle and bustle but close enough to explore when you want.

name: Christopher
review: Just as advertised. Great for multi-families, groups. Mix of bed types, for all ages. Would go back with a group and recommend to other groups. Good value! Communication with host just right.

name: Ana
review: We had a reunion gathering with 5 families. 12 adults and 11 kids ages 7 and under at Eugene's place. There were enough rooms but it was a tight squeeze with families of little people who require pack and plays to sleep in. The surrounding mountains were beautiful in the fall and the nearby state park was also gorgeous and worth the admission cost. Unfortunately the house was not as clean as we would have liked and the basement area had a distinguishable musty smell. Felt overpriced.

name: Hannah
review: The pictures don't do it enough justice the place is awesome!! We had a large group plus a dog and there was plenty of space! There are tons of rooms and beds for everyone and for the price you get a lot compared to other places. The bedrooms are cozy and quiet while the living room and kitchen provide large spaces for group games, movies and family meals. In the shared basement there is pool and ping pong and they provide space heaters to keep the space warm in winter. This is definitely a Vermont ski house. It's located very close to Bromley and several other mountains and really has a cozy vibe. Inside there is every appliance you could need including two dishwashers, two stove and ovens etc. A lovely laundry room too. The bathrooms were very clean and the showers had amazing hot water and pressure to warm up from outdoor activities. They also provided plenty of toilet paper, body wash, soap, and towels galore. The beds were so so comfy and clean and each room was unique. Some reviews mentioned loud street noise but we didn't notice this at all. There is a huge yard and the fire pit is great and has picnic tables for everyone to sit. There is plenty of parking and although it is located on a busy road the property and driveway are far enough back that safety is never a concern. The hosts were also very responsive throughout our stay. Eugene answered every odd question I had about the house and the area and even provided stores nearby. I have dealt with many hosts and I can't recommend Eugene enough. This group has gone on many trips big and small and this was definitely our favorite place. A great bang for your buck for large families or friends in a great location. We will definitely be back!

name: Heather
review: Our group of 9 loved our stay at the Emerald Lake Club, and the house could have accommodated a much larger group very comfortably. If you are looking for a house resembling a fancy hotel suite, this is NOT the house for you. But, if you are looking for a down-to-earth, unpretentious, comfortable, affordable home in a great location that can fit a large group, this is DEFINITELY the house for you! We felt very comfortable in the home. We visited in peak fall time, and even though it was chilly outside at night, it was warm inside. The house is a typical Vermont ski-style house with long cafeteria tables in the kitchen that fit a very large crowd. There are tons of mismatched dishes/ pots & pans/ silverware, enough to serve an army. There are two ovens, and two dishwashers (although we didn't need this amenity for our smallish group). No one had an issue with there not being enough hot water and the water pressure was very good. The owners were very good communicators and if we had a question they answered right away. On the last night we were able to have a fire in the firepit out back and the stars were just incredible! The house is right off of Route 7, and other reviewers mention the noise of the passing cars. If I hadn't read the other reviews I never would have noticed that. We barely noticed the sounds of cars passing, and would never have thought to write about it. Emerald Lake is only a short walk away, with places for picnics and barbeques. Manchester is only 10 minutes drive, the town of East Dorset is a few minutes drive. If you are going to Vermont in the winter, this house is centrally located to hit Mt. Snow, Stratton, Magic, Bromley, etc. If you're going up in the summer/fall, there are hiking trails everywhere, and lots of summer activities. I cannot say enough nice things about this house, it is exactly what we were looking for and we can't wait to go back!

name: Michael
review: This place was perfect for a group of friends to get together in beautiful New England. We cooked some delicious steaks on the grill, went hiking in nearby mountains, and swam at the lake next door, which is a two minute drive or 10 min walk. FYI theres a secret ropeswing at the lake. Ask someone local. The house is huge and there were sooo many beds to choose from. The kitchen had everything we needed. There was a billiards table with a ping pong attachment on top of it that we made great use of. The dining table was huge and accomodated all 12 of us. One of the things that we had no idea is that there was another unit attached to the house and when an older group pulled up to stay there, we were a bit concerned we would bother them. (we play instruments and have jam sessions). Luckily it seemed they were alright with it. Absolutely would do it again. We could live off of poutine and maple syrup. Thanks for a great stay.

name: Lisa
review: This was a great house for 5 families - 9 adults and 10 high school/college kids! It's rustic, casual, and comfortable - definitely what one would envision in VT. There are ample bedrooms for the adults, a great bunk room with a bathroom for the 6 boys, a good bedroom for 4 girls to share, and enough bathrooms for several people to use at once. The kitchen has more than enough room for prepping and cooking, as well as room for everyone to eat together. The kitchen is equipped with small appliances such as a toaster, toaster oven, and coffee maker; several pots and pans; more than enough dish-ware and utensils; and basic pantry items such as oil, vinegar and spices. The ping pong and pool tables were a hit with the kids after dinner; as mentioned in the description the basement smells musty. There is a fire pit in the backyard; we did borrow the lawn mower to take care of the grass around it for fear of embers or sparks. There is some road noise at night since the house is on the busy Route 7, but not bad for a few nights' stay. The house is near Emerald Lake and hiking trails and the Manchester Designer Outlets are close by. We had a great stay and would definitely return.

name: Aaron
review: I would 100% recommend this location especially to larger groups. The house allows for a group of friends to come together and have a great time together, and the outdoor area/lawn space is great for activities. The hosts were in the shared space for our trip and they were wonderful - they introduced themselves, made sure we had everything we needed, and then gave us our space for the weekend. Even though we were in a connected house with shared outdoor areas we felt as if we had the place to ourselves but also that if we needed anything they would be able to quickly assist. They did not interfere with our activities in any way. Overall this is a great location with amazing hosts, and I would recommend this to anyone looking to get away and spend some time in the beautiful VT countryside!

name: Brittany
review: We had a group of 9 staying in the house for a summer getaway. The house is in a good location close to downtown Manchester and a short walk from a state park with swimming, hiking, etc. It is right off the main road, convenient to get to but a fair bit of road noise. The house had plenty of room for us, however it was a hot weekend and the upstairs was too hot/stuffy and everyone crammed downstairs so it didn't feel as spacious as it actually was. The listing notes it was updated recently, however the house is still pretty rough around the edges. Good for a group who maybe doesn't plan to spend most of the day at the house. Our group found the beds on the uncomfortable side and there were pillowcases/sheets missing so I recommend you bring your own linens. The owners' house is attached to the rental house and the basement is shared. There looked to be a nice fire pit in the backyard but it was too hot to enjoy a fire, would be great on a cool spring or fall evening! The price is much lower than many other places in the area, which I think reflects some of the updating that still needs to be done. Overall a good place for a large group looking for a no-frills weekend getaway.

name: Trevor
review: This was the perfect spot for us to spend time together as a family. Emerald Lake was beautiful and an easy short walk from the house. Close enough to Manchester, but a nice distance from the hustle and bustle of the city. Eugene was a great host and the space was clean and had plenty of amenities. We will certainly consider this place for future trips!

name: Donna
review: We had a wonderful family Thanksgiving at the Emerald Lake House. There was plenty of room for our group of 11. The place is unique and obviously old (as in historic with original wood plank floors, etc). The bedrooms were small but cozy. And communication with the hosts was excellent. Grocery stores were just a short drive which was very convenient. We gather in a different place for the holiday every year, so we may not be back, but it was certainly a fun place to stay.

name: Brandon
review: Beautiful spot. Road noise is an issue as Vermont residents fly down the road. Emerald lake is beautiful and worth the trip. This spot is great for a big family outing. The beds were uncomfortable and there was a lack of cleaning supplies are my only complaints. Everything else was great.

name: Angela
review: There are so many beautiful amazing things to say about our stay I don't even know where to start! We were with a very large group and Eugene was more than accommodating! Between the gorgeous murals on the barn, fire pit great for gathering, large kitchen table for getting together for meals and a beautiful view of the mountains that never end. We had everything we needed! 10/10 would recommend and go again!

name: Elisabeth
review: This house can sleep a lot of people, If that's what you need, and I can imagine it would be great in the winter. In summer, it's a bit stuffy and disconnected to the outside, and also sits on a very major road with high speed traffic. The state park next door is a little less than 10 mins walking, and has a $4pp rate of entry. Over all, a little rough around the edges but a decent place to stay if VT is where you want to be.

name: Grant
review: Thoroughly enjoyed Eugene's location, surrounded by glorious hills and waterways. The location is well suited for large groups of people, especially the very welcoming kitchen space. Group lunches and dinners were great. Overall had a lovely time and made some great memories in the lovely Vermont air. Definitely check this place out!

name: Kylie
review: The house was great for a bigger sized group. Great location to the lake and plenty of room for activities in the yard. It was a great place to getaway and will definitely will be staying here again we loved it.

name: Maria
review: My family of 7 spent 4 days here. Its a unique and fun place to stay! It accomodated my children and granddaughter (ages 3-25) and there was something for everyone! When it was rainy we utilized the ping-pong and pool table in the basement. We hiked through Emerald lake state park from the back yard and spent a day at the beach swimming and kayaking. The kitchen was great, it was perfect for cooking for my large family. We found the beds to be very comfortable. There was some road noise to be heard at night but I am the only one out of 7 that really heard it. Our second day there my kids were talking about coming back again! I contacted the hosts with a few things and got very quick responses.

name: Omkar
review: Location of Eugene's place is perfect for a fall foliage trip. cozy little place for family gatherings. Fully furnished and kitchen is also well stocked, you have everything you need. Huge dining room perfect for large groups. please note that rooms are little tinier than what the photos show, especially restrooms. We didn't have many issues, except one restroom's flush stopped working. But there are other restrooms in house, so we didn't complain. host is very responsive and will get all necessary information needed.

name: Harmony
review: Beautiful spot. Mountains in every direction. Road noise is an issue as Vermont residents fly down the road and in the summer the windows are open and could hear the trucks all night. Emerald lake is beautiful and worth the trip. The kids had a great time swimming, kayaking, and using SUP. The location is great because it is close to Manchester for food and great bookstore as well as Dorset Quarry which we spent multiple days at because the kids loved swimming and jumping off the cliffs! This spot is good for a big family outing and fits lots of people. Kids had fun in the bunk room. The beds were very uncomfortable, even the kids commented on how uncomfortable the beds were. If you are a group that loves to cook make sure to bring your own cooking items as there weren't pots or pans for large meal prep and kitchen equipment utensils were old and worn - one of the stove's burners doesn't work so we were cooking with 3 burners/toaster wasn't toasting, etc.

name: Ron
review: We had a great stay in Dorset. The house is really big, with plenty of room for our 20 guests. Location right next to Emerald State Park was very nice, and the house is located on a beautiful piece of property with great views and easy access to all that Vermont has to offer.

name: Amber
review: The place was exactly what we expected, you can't beat the beauty of Vermont, and the hosts were fantastic! A friend left behind something very important and the hosts were able to locate it and help return it to them; above and beyond kindness and understanding.

name: Tina
review: There was plenty of room to accommodate our group, but the house was a bit of a disappointment, primarily because of its lack of cleanliness and safety. The kitchen tables were sticky and stained no matter what I did, I couldn't get rid of the stickiness. Recommend bringing tablecloths. The floors and rugs were really dirty. Additionally, the house had a lot of functionality/ safety issues, including the windows and screens not functioning properly, including the front entrance window being broken (which could result in safety concerns/ unwanted access), the house entrance door would stick and was extremely difficult to open, and front steps were loose and wobbly.

name: Jess
review: This home is located 3 minutes from the Vermont Summer Festival Horse Show grounds- which was a great location for our time at the house. The washer and dryer were great assets for us for the week- and there was plenty of space for all of us to have our own rooms. Eugene was incredibly communicative throughout the entire process- answering questions for locations of items, helping us figure out a local swimming spot (walking distance from the house- and totally amazing place to swim!).

name: James
review: This is my first time booking a stay with Eugene but my second time staying at this house. I would recommend staying here knowing that it's not a 5 star accommodation but a very large house that has a lot to offer. The grill worked great and got up to temp fast. the only downside to our stay was that the shower water temp was faintly comfortable. I notified Eugene after our stay. He asked questions to get further information and has notified me that the plumber will be fixing asap for the next guests. To wrap up, again I'd recommend this location to host a good amount of people and to enjoy what VT has to offer.

name: El
review: Definitely worth staying here. Great hosts and excellent location with a lot to do. House is big and awesome if you're going away with a lot of people with plenty of parking. Will definitely rent again in the future.

name: Sean
review: Great area, great adventuring to do in town and in nature. I little cramped in the bathrooms and not alot of seating in basement rec area but got the job done. The veiw was great though and it was an awsome place to spend our weekend.

name: Liana
review: Location of home was perfect for our summer stay as it was conveniently located next to the lake and not far from shops. Kitchen was also a great size for our group to cook and eat together.

name: Jared
review: Place was very clean and the space was perfect for my organization's retreat! Hopefully will look into booking it again next year!

name: Donald
review: Beautiful house and beautiful location! Great price for the amount of people it can host. The owners are very friendly and very helpful. Would highly recommend! Our group really enjoyed our stay.

name: Bridget
review: We had such a great time here with a large group of friends. The place is spacious and clean. It's also very well-designed for large groups - big kitchen, lots of dining table space, plenty of bathrooms and bedrooms. The location is gorgeous - perfect for experiencing the fall leaves and hiking. Eugene is very responsive and helped us with everything we could have needed. Highly recommend this place!

name: Natasha
review: The house is very spacious, easily accessible, and in a great location! Eugene was a great host, it was easy to communicate with him and he was very informative and hospitable.

name: Dan
review: I was in the area hosting a training and I was able to have my cadre of instructors under one roof at Eugene's Airbnb. The rustic house was ready, clean, and had everything we needed for the week! Eugene was quick to respond to any questions that we had. I will stay there again when I am in the area again next year.

name: Valerie
review: Great place for large family to stay. It was close to town. Some traffic noise as it was right off the road with a lot of traffic. Good response time from host.

name: Sue
review: Nice spot. Spitting distance to Emerald Park and a short drive to Manchester and lots of scenic outdoor adventures.

name: John
review: The place was not clean on arrival. In the kitchen everything felt sticky and dirty. The toilets weren't clean and had urine on them. The windows were dirty, the railing upstairs broken and unsafe. The door is broken to one of the bedrooms. I realize the place isn't advertised as being a five star resort but cleanliness and things being in good repair are minimum expectations.

name: Miranda
review: Very unique place, great for bigger groups. All of the owners were very friendly and quickly to respond.

name: Christopher
review: A great house in a great location! Eugene was extremely helpful. We will definitely be coming back!

name: Alban
review: Good place to stay if you would like to have a ski trip in Vermont, Very Spacious (the largest airbnb I have ever seen), good for a large group.

name: Samantha
review: A wonderful rustic stay, with vibrant 80's ski lodge feel. 100% large enough for you and your crew, while still having enough space to feed an army! The lake next door is a hidden gem and a new favorite you and your family will fall for.

name: Greg
review: This is an amazing spot to come and visit. Host is super nice and was willing to help us with anything we need and suggested a lot of cool hikes and swimming spots. I would 100% recommend this place to anybody interested!

name: Aleyda
review: It was a grate stay for a group of 16 with kids too, a lot of space for everyone, there's a shared house next to it. Bed rooms and bathroom very clean and organized. We all had a grate time locations for lakes and more are beautiful just a few minutes away from the house

name: Kale
review: Cozy and spacious. I booked this place for myself and my groomsmen. Perfect space for our purposes.

name: Dario
review: Excellent place and the water is good to drink easy to locate the place and plenty of rooms to accommodate people. They have enough space for parking.

name: Erin
review: Great place for a group. The kitchen area sat us all!!! It is in a beautiful location. Walking distance to Emerald Lake!

name: Sloop
review: Great place, friendly owners! Got to meet them and their friends a couple of nights and spent some time together around the fire in the back. Do mind that you are right on route 7 here and guest entrance is near the street.

name: Ellen
review: This is a cool space with lots of room for everyone and a great location near hiking and Emerald Lake State Park.

name: Ally
review: Easy, quality service from nice people. Perfect for my wedding weekend at the lake! Thank you Eugene!

name: Gary
review: We loved the house and location. We could not have had a better time. The house offered everything we needed or wanted. Thanks You, Gary

name: Jeff
review: The location was easy to get to, and there is space for a lot of guests.

name: Erik
review: The space is massive, but each bedroom is quite private. It's great to build a bonfire in the back yard, too.

name: Robert
review: Nothing fancy, but a great stay, nonetheless.

name: Suzi
review: Loved that it was clean and beds were made and clean when we got arrived after our long drive. Owner did a great job with communications & was flexible with checkout when our horse show divisions were were pushed back due to weather the next day. I wished we had more time to explore and hike. I have been to VT to ski and this is the perfect location for skiing. Definitely considering a return for a group ski getaway. Vermont was actually hot this time of the year, I was never here in the summer before it would have been great to have time to swim at Emerald lake if we could have extended our stay by a few days. Thanks for everything Eugene

name: Richard
review: Large group fit well.

name: Mathilda
review: Eugene's place was perfect for our family

name: Baian
review: Very spacious place and beautiful location

name: Benjamin
review: A great place to stay! Spent every morning walking over to Emerald Lake State Park. No better way to start a day. The Alice in Wonderland mural out behind the house is also a must see

name: Kerry
review: It's a great place for large groups.

name: Rafael
review: Great host, kind and accommodating! Nice space for big groups, we enjoyed our stay at Eugene's

name: Dhayakarthik
review: Value for money

name: Rohan
review: Very good
